text: This animal, fo fo and lo simple in its nature and disposition, is likewise extremely weak and feeble in its condition: They can endere but little fingers when ever they ran, their hearts pute, and their wind falls there, they are equally incapable of clearing her or cold, fawor or rain: They are fuject to many difades, molt of which the consensus: They bring forth their young with pain and difficulty, and require more care and attention than any other scientific animal.
